Collector summary (not verbatim source text): BEV range, best variant — standard: 713 km CLTC, 97 kWh battery. Notes: i5 eDrive35L 602 km CLTC (81.6 kWh), xDrive50L 651 km CLTC (97 kWh). CN i5 gets a larger 97 kWh pack than the EU/US 81.2 kWh. CLTC is not comparable to WLTP/EPA. Launch MSRPs 368,000 / 408,000 / 458,000 CNY.

Collector summary (not verbatim source text): BEV DC fast charging: peak kW, 10-80 % time, voltage — standard: DC 30-80 % in 0.6 h (approx. 36 min); peak kW and voltage not listed.
